bundle.shortDescription: Mix, tune, sync and export home-recorded music covers
bundle.longDescription: Cover Studio turns a phone video or home recording of a music cover into a polished post: voice/instrument separation, gentle pitch correction, mixing and mastering, audio/video sync, take selection, social video export, thumbnail and caption.
